reason: A web-based DSH plugin manager for runtime plugin enable, disable, restart, bundle hot-mounting, and persistence of plugin states; its lifecycle-control HTTP endpoints create elevated operational risk.

summaries.zh: 通过 Web 界面管理 DSH 插件的运行时启用、停用、重启、热挂载及持久化状态。
summaries.en: Manage DSH plugins through a web interface with runtime enable, disable, restart, hot-mounting, and persistent state controls.

capabilities: Runtime enable, disable, and restart of plugins
Automatic hot-mounting and unloading of bundles based on profile package.json changes
Persistence of plugin disabled states in cordis.patch.yml
Same-origin HTTP endpoints for plugin lifecycle control
